notes: All nine explicit USD minor-unit buyer/fee/seller triples match section282. Runtime table and entries are frozen; getPriceTier returns a copy.
Regression compares every canonical triple to the exact section282 table rather than deriving fees by rounding.
Job admission and ledger consume the shared fixed-tier snapshot; web renders API tier values. Existing jobs persist integer snapshots independently of later publications.

Normalized strict schema includes all eleven field types, stable keys, labels, order, constraints and groups. No separate per-format primitive. Broad section is not certified across every rendered field/type combination.
Required is a strict boolean on input/output fields; missing required active values and nonexistent file references fail actual validation.
User contract regex, patternProperties and recursive references are rejected before schema compilation. JSON schema depth/size and compiled-validator cache are bounded.

Authoritative upload/result bytes, filename extension and detected MIME are checked independently of browser claims. Runtime formats are narrower than storage and have an explicit compatibility gate; not all requested media formats are supported.
Browser MIME never suffices: bytes are inspected before private storage and returned results are revalidated. This is format validation, not a claim of malware-free content.
Groups are optional flat string labels. Conditions use one declared key and literal equality; no arbitrary expression evaluator or recursive field schema is exposed.
Conditional fields are resolved independently of display order, including controller defaults and hidden descendants; inactive submitted values and dependency cycles are rejected.
Only key-equals-string/number/boolean conditions are accepted by strict runtime schemas. No execution of buyer-supplied expressions.
Product-specific versioned normalized IO contract is authoritative; JSON Schema validates bounded JSON fields, not arbitrary file-upload behavior.
Defaults are type/constraint checked and condition-aware; file defaults and output defaults are forbidden. Full section-specific browser acceptance remains limited.
Schedules persist IANA timezone names. Spring/fall Zurich DST and overnight boundaries are tested with real wall-clock conversion rather than fixed UTC offsets.
Deterministic schedule/override/DST/readiness/concurrency predicates and API dispatch regressions pass. Complete real-device sleeping/waking and clock-change acceptance is not claimed.
An open schedule cannot override offline, paused, insecure, missing-sandbox or unknown dependency readiness. Tests independently flip these gates.
